scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @hireheaven/shared && concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,utils,notification,user,job,application,web "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/gateway" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/auth" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/utils" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/notification" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/user" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/job" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/application" "npm run dev --workspace @hireheaven/web"
scripts.migrate:all: docker compose build auth notification user job application && docker compose run --rm --no-deps auth npm run migrate:up --workspace @hireheaven/auth && docker compose run --rm --no-deps notification npm run migrate:up --workspace @hireheaven/notification && docker compose run --rm --no-deps user npm run migrate:up --workspace @hireheaven/user && docker compose run --rm --no-deps job npm run migrate:up --workspace @hireheaven/job && docker compose run --rm --no-deps application npm run migrate:up --workspace @hireheaven/application
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @hireheaven/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck tests/e2e/job-application-flow.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @hireheaven/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
